description: Reversing the combination up a 6% ramp (dock approach) at 4 km/h target

checks.source: ramp reversing speed bounded: SpeedFwd < 0 in reverse, |v| <= 12 km/h means min_speed_kmh >= -12
engine stays above idle (idle 600 rpm; bound 550 guards lugging/stall)
makes progress up the ramp: >= 8 m displacement in 40 s at 4 km/h target (4 km/h x 40 s = 44 m theoretical, minus ramp-up)
heading 0, grade rises towards +z: reversing up the ramp means z decreases by >= 5 m
trailer stays aligned in straight reverse: articulation << mechanical stop +/-90 deg
no wheel lift on the ramp
no solver explosion / impulse spikes (per-step velocity change of either body)
